Production asset: the EXACT20 facial-expression categories from the user's reference board, for Amanda. Polished ILLUSTRATED COMIC / CARTOON visual-novel artwork, crisp dark ink outlines, soft cel-shaded colors and expressive adult acting. This must read as2D illustrated game art. Exactly4equal columns by5equal rows on a tall transparent atlas ideally2048x2560. 20separate complete heads. Clear transparent gutters. Read row-by-row:
ROW1: Neutral (attentive closed mouth); Happy (warm open smile); Smiling (subtle closed-lip smile); Wink (one eye closed).
ROW2: Laughing (open joyful laugh); Playful (mischievous raised eyebrow); Seductive (self-possessed soft half-lidded gaze); Lip Bite (very light lower-lip bite).
ROW3: Licking Lips (a tiny tongue tip brushing one lip corner); Surprised (wide eyes and parted lips); Angry (firm knitted brows); Annoyed (unimpressed narrowed eyes).
ROW4: Sad (quiet downturned expression); Crying (natural small tears, no flood); Terrified (frightened wide eyes and drawn brows); Disgusted (small nose wrinkle).
ROW5: Talking (clearly speaking mouth); Arguing (animated brows and emphatic open mouth); Drunk (flushed cheeks, loose unfocused smile); Nervous (uncertain brows and tense little smile).
Make all20 unmistakably different while preserving identity and age.  No sexual acts, no scenery. No labels, words, borders, icons or panels. Actual transparent alpha backdrop. Every whole head and all hair inside its own equal cell, no overlap. This is for automatic extraction into dialogue-window side portraits.
